puntos: Latest update going live Tuesday, June 2nd at 8:30 AM PT. We’ve actually already updated this with no downtime, so enjoy the changes below now!

General UpdatesUpgrades 2.0: The future is now, pilots. Our brand new upgrade feature is here, and it’s all about catering and building your aircraft to match your preferred playstyle(s). Here’s a summary of what you can expect to see.

Aircraft Upgrades still exist, however once you reach Aircraft Level 6, you’ll unlock access to individual Systems on your plane: Fuselage, Engine, Avionics, and various weapons systems depending on your loadout. Each of these systems has 8 levels which will drastically alter your aircraft’s capabilities like never before.

These new system upgrades introduce new resource types: System Parts + Advanced Parts. Don’t worry–your upgrades and power from before will be carrying over. Based on a number of conditions, existing accounts will also receive a number of resources during this migration. Make sure you check your system messages!

puntos: This update is set to go live Wednesday, March 11th at 8:30 AM PT. This update will not require a new client download.

[h3]General Updates[/h3]Special Flight Pass Event: We have brand new choice-based opportunities launching with the upcoming First Light Flight Pass. We’ve created 2 new case types: Ability & Mod Cases. When you collect one of these nodes in the flight pass, you will be given up to 3 random options based on your hangar for you to choose from. Developer Note: If you do not have any mods/abilities available you will receive silver instead.

Alongside this, we’ve updated our reward tracks with even more Silver + Universal Parts than ever before. Not just that, but this “Draw 3 Pick 1” system will appear for every opportunity you would receive an ability/mod drop from a specially-marked FL crate. This season is all about giving you more control on the things you earn, and where your upgrades go. Enjoy!

First Light Flight Pass: Speaking of the flight pass, this new one will go live on Saturday, March 14th, 2026, at 9:00 AM PST. Make sure to grab yours at http://playmetalstorm.com/shop so your squadmates can gain access to bonus Silver, and so you can net yourself some Star Points to boot!

posts.author_title: Starform Dev Team · Lead Combat Designer
posts.titulo_es: 🔥 [REWORK MAYOR] F-15 Eagle: Habilidad Especial «Death Sparrows», Salto al Meta A-Tier y Calibración Completa de Maniobrabilidad
posts.titulo_en: 🔥 [MAJOR REWORK] F-15 Eagle: «Death Sparrows» Special Ability, A-Tier Meta Ascent & Full Maneuverability Overhaul
posts.resumen_es: El F-15 Eagle recibe una reconstrucción integral de su rol en combate aéreo. Se reemplaza la antigua habilidad pasiva genérica de enfriamiento por «Death Sparrows», convirtiéndolo en un destructor ofensivo capaz de vulnerar bengalas a media distancia.
posts.resumen_en: The F-15 Eagle receives a complete combat role overhaul. Generic cooling/refuel abilities are replaced with «Death Sparrows», making it a devastating mid-range dogfighter capable of bypassing countermeasures.

puntos: Mecánica Ofensiva: Los misiles disparados bajo Death Sparrows ignoran bengalas (flares) enemigas en su trayectoria inicial.
Compensación Táctica: Se retira la recarga defensiva de bengalas. El F-15 ahora premia el posicionamiento agresivo y la anticipación sobre la defensa pasiva.
Letalidad a Media Distancia: Daño por impacto concentrado optimizado contra cazas medianos y pesados.
Tasa de Viraje (Pitch & Roll): Aceleración de giro incrementada en un +14% a velocidades subsónicas y supersónicas.
Respuesta de Postquemador: Transición más suave sin pérdida drástica de energía cinética en maniobras de tijeras (scissors).
Posición en Meta: Ascenso directo de B-Tier a Tier A+ competitivo en Combate por Equipos y Superioridad Aérea.
Offensive Mechanics: Missiles launched with Death Sparrows active bypass enemy flares during their initial track phase.
Tactical Trade-off: Defensive flare reload has been removed. The F-15 now rewards aggressive offensive positioning.
Mid-Range Lethality: Concentrated impact damage tuned specifically against medium and heavy fighters.
Turn Rates (Pitch & Roll): Turn rate acceleration increased by +14% across subsonic and supersonic profiles.
Afterburner Response: Smoother kinetic retention in scissors and horizontal rolling engagements.
Tier Ranking: Pushed directly from lower B-Tier into competitive Tier A+.

posts.author: u/MetalstormBalanceTeam
posts.titulo_es: ⚡ [BALANCE DE CAZAS] Ajustes a A-4 Skyhawk, F-106 Delta Dart, F-4 Phantom y Mecánica de Viraje de Misiles Guiados
posts.titulo_en: ⚡ [AIRCRAFT BALANCE] Adjustments to A-4 Skyhawk, F-106 Delta Dart, F-4 Phantom & Guided Missile Turn Rates
posts.resumen_es: Ajustes de equilibrio táctico destinados a diversificar el meta competitivo y balancear la efectividad del combate a corta distancia frente a interceptores pesados.
posts.resumen_en: Tactical balance tuning aimed at expanding competitive meta diversity and leveling close-range turn-fighters with high-altitude interceptors.

secciones_es.titulo: A-4 Skyhawk (Ajuste a la baja / Nerf)
puntos: Salud Base Reducida: Pasa de 155 a 145 para castigar sobreextensiones en dogfights cerrados.
Enfriamiento de Cañones: Tiempo de disipación de calor aumentado en 0.4s tras ráfagas continuas.
Salud Base Aumentada: De 135 a 150 HP.
Tanques de Combustible Externos: Capacidad de combustible de postquemador incrementada en +12%.
Generación Pasiva: Tasa de recarga de habilidad de interceptación optimizada.
F-4 Phantom: Misiles IR sustituidos por pods de cohetes ligeros; munición de misiles manuales de medio alcance incrementada de 4 a 6.
J-20 Mighty Dragon: Dispersión y cono de fijación ajustados para evitar spam monótono de misiles de largo alcance.
Base HP Reduced: Decreased from 155 to 145 to increase vulnerability in sustained dogfights.
Cannon Heat Cooling: Heat dissipation window increased by 0.4s after sustained burst fire.
Base HP Increased: Up from 135 to 150 HP.
External Fuel Pods: Afterburner fuel reserve capacity increased by +12%.
Passive Generation: Tactical interception readiness rate accelerated.
F-4 Phantom: IR missiles replaced with Light Rocket Pods; manual medium-range missile capacity raised from 4 to 6.
J-20 Mighty Dragon: Long-range missile tracking cone adjusted to tone down repetitive long-distance missile spam.

posts.author: u/StarformEngineTeam
posts.titulo_es: 🖥️ [SISTEMAS PC] Optimización del Cliente de Escritorio: Pantallas Ultra-Wide 21:9, Mapeo HOTAS/Teclado y Netcode de Servidores
posts.titulo_en: 🖥️ [PC SYSTEMS] Desktop Client Optimization: 21:9 Ultra-Wide Support, Custom Controls & Server Netcode Enhancements
posts.resumen_es: Actualización técnica integral para la versión de PC y Steam: compatibilidad nativa con resoluciones panorámicas, calibración de entrada sin latencia y sincronización de servidores.
posts.resumen_en: Major performance update for the PC & Steam ecosystem: native ultra-wide field of view, low-latency control mapping, and improved squadron server synchronization.

puntos: Ultra-Wide (21:9 & 32:9): Corrección de FOV en cabina y menús sin estiramiento de textura ni barras negras.
Input Latency: Reducción de latencia de entrada en un 15% para teclados mecánicos y joysticks.
Netcode de Escuadrones: Mayor estabilidad en salas con 10 pilotos simultáneos y reducción drástica de micro-rubberbanding.
Ultra-Wide (21:9 & 32:9): Corrected aspect ratio scaling for widescreen monitors without stretching or letterboxing.
Input Latency: Input lag reduced by ~15% for gaming keyboards and flight controllers.
Squadron Netcode: Smoother position replication for 10-player rooms, virtually eliminating micro-rubberbanding.
